protocol_corrections: Qwen JSON warmups_per_block actually means one warmup phase before all counterbalanced blocks, as the archived drivers show. No timings were regenerated or changed by this clarification.

Baseline decode rates include full-logit host collection; public generate wall is recorded separately.
First requests use fresh runners but sequential shared JIT cache state. The p513 point includes first-use compilation; these are not uniformly cold-JIT replicates.
